GiftTurntable.title: GiftTurntable
GiftTurntable.description: A personalized 3D vinyl turntable gift configuration belonging to a creator and shareable via a unique gift ID.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who owns this gift.

clientLabel.description: Internal label to identify the client or recipient in the creator library.

eyebrow.description: Short eyebrow header shown at the top of the turntable view.

subtitle.description: Subtitle or brief instruction displayed under the title.

signature.description: Creator signature shown at the bottom of the dedication modal.

framePhotoUrl.description: Optional photo URL displayed inside the 3D picture frame across all environments.

discs.description: Ordered list of 1 to 12 vinyl discs included in the gift.

isPublished.description: Whether the gift link is active for recipients to view via direct ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the gift document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

MediaAsset.title: MediaAsset
MediaAsset.description: Catalog entry for an uploaded audio MP3 or cover photo owned by a creator so it can be reused across gifts without duplicate uploads.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator who uploaded this asset.

title.description: Human-friendly song or cover title shown in the reusable library.

fileName.description: Original filename used to detect duplicate uploads.

fileSize.description: Original file size in bytes for duplicate detection.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the uploaded media asset.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the media entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/gifts/{giftId}.description: Stores each client/recipient turntable gift configuration keyed by its shareable gift ID.

/media_library/{mediaId}.description: Private creator catalog of previously uploaded MP3 audio tracks and cover images for reuse across client gifts.
